question: Total available units across all warehouses
Count warehouses by region
oracle_sql: SELECT region,COUNT(*) FROM warehouses GROUP BY region

question: Count items by category
oracle_sql: SELECT category,COUNT(*) FROM items GROUP BY category

question: Count shipped shipments
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipments WHERE state='shipped'

question: Available units by item category
oracle_sql: SELECT i.category,SUM(s.on_hand-s.reserved) FROM stock s JOIN items i ON i.item_id=s.item_id GROUP BY i.category

question: Count pending shipments by warehouse region
oracle_sql: SELECT w.region,COUNT(*) FROM shipments sh JOIN warehouses w ON sh.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id WHERE sh.state='pending' GROUP BY w.region

question: Total value of available stock by category
oracle_sql: SELECT i.category,ROUND(SUM((s.on_hand-s.reserved)*i.unit_cost),2) FROM stock s JOIN items i ON i.item_id=s.item_id GROUP BY i.category

question: Count item-warehouse pairs with more than 40 available units
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock WHERE on_hand-reserved > 40

question: Total shipped quantity by warehouse
oracle_sql: SELECT warehouse_id,SUM(quantity) FROM shipments WHERE state='shipped' GROUP BY warehouse_id

question: Which item category has the greatest available quantity? Return category and units
oracle_sql: SELECT i.category,SUM(s.on_hand-s.reserved) AS qty FROM stock s JOIN items i ON i.item_id=s.item_id GROUP BY i.category ORDER BY qty DESC,i.category LIMIT 1
